_doc: Runway-number corrections applied by `iaf-terrain details` (deliberate rendering improvement over the 1998 data).
Some runway-end numbers in the map.ptt airbase insets were painted wrongly by the original artists: a number N
must read upright to a pilot landing on that end (facing heading N*10), but these read as mirror images.
The terrain itself is correctly oriented; only the digit patch is re-sampled. See docs/formats/ptt.md,
'Runway number fix (rendering improvement)', for the survey of every number in the detail tiles.
Fields: centre = patch centre in world units (the map.ptt / detail-tile coordinate system: x east, y south,
1 unit = 1 detail pixel; pixel (px,py) of tile d_gx_gy covers base_rect[0]+gx*2048+px .. +1);
heading_deg = landing direction of that runway end (compass: 0 = north = -y, 90 = east = +x), i.e. the runway
axis; half_across / half_along = half size of the rectangular patch across / along the runway (units);
op = 'mirror' (reflect across the runway centreline through `centre`) or 'rotate180' (point reflection about
`centre`); feather = width of the linear blend at the patch edge (units).
